verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Runbooks are explicitly documented as the automation engine that attach to incidents (including a Default Runbook auto-attached to every incident) and execute steps like assigning roles, creating Slack channels/Jira tickets, adding task lists, and sending webhooks to trigger diagnostics/rollbacks — all triggering automatically when incidents are declared based on evaluated conditions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of runbook automation reliability beyond vendor docs, and no explicit named 'diagnostics' step type (only inferred via webhook/integration steps).
